description: Standard SAE J2012 DTCs and Ford/Mazda Enhanced Diagnostic Trouble Codes

dtcs.description: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Range/Performance
dtcs.symptom: Engine hesitation, rough idle, poor fuel economy.

dtcs.description: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit High Input
dtcs.symptom: Check Engine Light, possible rich fuel mixture.

dtcs.description: Engine Coolant Temperature Circuit High Input
dtcs.symptom: Cooling fans running continuously, high idle.
Vacuum leak, weak fuel pump, or contaminated MAF sensor.
Flashing Check Engine Light, engine stumbling, catalytic converter damage risk.
Rough idle, hesitation, ignition coil or spark plug failure.
Catalytic converter degraded or downstream O2 sensor fault.

dtcs.description: On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) Systems Readiness Test Not Complete
dtcs.symptom: Vehicle battery was disconnected or DTCs were recently cleared. Normal during drive cycle.

subTypes.0A: Component Low Resistance (Battery degradation or weak charge)

dtcs.symptom: Ford BMS reports 12V battery health degraded, low state of charge, or auto start-stop disabled.
System voltage dropped below 10.0V during cranking or operation.
ABS and Traction Control lights illuminated, cruise control disabled.
ABS warning light, wheel speed erratic or circuit open.
CAN bus communication timeout with engine controller.
CAN bus timeout with transmission controller.

dtcs.description: Lost Communication With Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) Control Module
dtcs.symptom: ABS communication error on HS-CAN bus.

dtcs.description: Lost Communication With Body Control Module
Lost Communication With Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) Control Module
dtcs.symptom: Cluster gauges freeze or warning lights illuminate.
